say:0:1410423001:1.text: The water basin's magical fluctuations resemble the Divine Dew of the royal city, though noticeably diluted.
say:0:1410423001:1.source_cn: 水盆之中的魔力波动与王城内的恩典灵露近似，只是明显感受...

say:1:1410423002:1.text: Despite being placed in the commoners' district, its design feels far beyond their craftsmanship.
say:1:1410423002:1.source_cn: 盛放恩典灵露的容器虽说被摆放在平民区，但布置却异于平民...
